entries.content:
Last year, private company Majestic Care bought four state-owned nursing homes, which for decades had been run by the state. Some families and workers were fearful of cuts while others were hopeful.

Public Health Reporter Erin Beck wants to know what’s changed. 

Have you or your family members tried to get care at one of the hospitals or had other experiences you would like to share with us about Hopemont Hospital, Jackie Withrow Hospital, Lakin Hospital or John Manchin Sr. Health Care Center? Are you a current or former employee who wants to share your experience? Do you have another connection to a facility?

Please share your experience at the survey below.
